product_metadata.title: 1000 Thread Count Oversized King Duvet Cover 120X98 100% Egyptian Cotton Breathable All Season with Zipper Closure & Corner Ties Soft Comforter Cover by Kotton Culture (Oversized King, White)
features: SIZE INFORMATION: 1 Oversized King Duvet Cover (120"X98")

PURE EGYPTIAN COTTON BEDDING: Kotton Culture's Premium Cotton Bedding is naturally soft and breathable. Our thick Duvet Cover is designed using a tighter fabric weave to give it extra softness and durability. Get rid of dust-trapping microfiber and bring home the luxurious hotel experience with cotton fiber with a smooth sateen finish.

ZIPPER CLOSURE & CORNER TIES: Each cotton duvet cover features a hidden, hassle-free zipper closure, easier than regular button closure, so you can conveniently get your comforter in and out of this cover. The quilt cover also has 7 internal ties to prevent slippage, keeping your insert in place.

ELEGANT DESIGN IN 1000 TC: Our Duvet Covers are available in a wide range of vibrant colors. The craftsmanship of 1000 threads per inch provides a blend of softness, durability, and year-round comfort—use the cooling duvet covers in the summer or layer in the winter.

EASY CARE: This classic blanket cover is finished with high-strength stitching and is low-maintenance. Machine wash in cold water, tumble dry low, and iron when needed. If you prefer wrinkle-free bedding, use a short dry cycle and take your cover out promptly from the dryer.

BUY ETHICALLY MADE PRODUCTS: Make a better choice for the planet with a high-quality, earth-friendly pinch pleat comforter set, crafted in a socially responsible manner and individually inspected. Get the luxury of tencel and the cheap pricing of microfibre with Kotton Culture’s Egyptian Cotton bedding basics store that offers pintucked bedspreads, bedsheets, kitchen linen, curtain, fluffy waffle blankets, and heavyweight down alternative comforters in striped, solid, and printed collections.
